method: Regularized equal-prior Gaussian discriminant over16 gain-invariant spatial/band/envelope features, equal total source weight,50 whole-source bootstrap fits and leave-one-source-out gates.
settings_policy: Caller supplies complete native controls for each scene class. The classifier does not learn preferred width or listener utility.
uncertainty: Fifth-percentile bootstrap score>=0.95 and nearest same-class support RMS distance<=1.5. Heuristic abstention, not calibrated probability or preference confidence.
native_qualification: Exact binary identity; current complete native schema; sample headroom<=0.999, RMS level change within+/-6dB, mono energy fraction>=0.01, mono relative RMS error<=1e-6, fresh JSON preset reopen<=1e-7. No normalization, true-peak guarantee or finite IIR tail claim.
finding: All72 labelled procedural gain conditions classified correctly by both the full model and one-feature nearest-centroid baseline.50 native proposals admitted;24 loud variants plus silent, one-silent-channel and antiphase probes abstain. Identical PCM with different intended uses gets identical settings; desired effect side energy falls3.374dB. No learned superiority or perceptual adoption.
remaining: Adequate real source-labelled scenes and user policy/preference evidence
Independent source/rate/duration/channel-balance shifts, stronger baselines and calibrated abstention
Listening and host/resource/cross-platform acceptance; local example binds a specific QA executable
